messages:
arjun: hey all, i'm Arjun (joined infra today). i'm trying to get access to Redwood Console (staging admin) and Requesting flags-admin for LaunchDarkly. in Okta i only see 'Console (viewer)'. who should i ask?

sam: welcome Arjun :wave: For staging admin we use Okta group `console-admin-staging` (self-serve). Prod admin is `console-admin` and needs manager approval + security review. If you can't see the staging group open ENG-IT and @me.

isabel: hi Arjun! i'm your manager. i'll approve the prod request once you open the ticket. please include which flags and an expiry. we default to 30 days for new hires.

arjun: thanks. what info should be in the ENG-IT ticket exactly?

sam: paste this body into ENG-IT (minimal):

```
Request: console-admin-prod (and console-admin-staging if needed), flags-admin (LaunchDarkly)
Manager: Isabel Gupta
Justification: Short purpose and which services will be changed
Flags: infra_rollback_flag, new_scheduler_toggle
Expiry: 2024-10-01
Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%; metrics: error_rate, p99 latency; rollback criteria: >2% error increase or p99 > 2x baseline
```

ld-admin: also send your LaunchDarkly username in the ticket. we'll provision `flags-admin` scoped to those projects. we prefer expiry and least privilege.

infra-bot: Tip: to preview flag state in staging run `rdwctl flags get <flag> --env=staging --whoami` before toggling.

arjun: i registered for 2FA and my yubikey last night. any other pre-req?

security-bot: good. security note: prod admin grants are audited. include the ENG-IT ticket number and list the exact flags. for any flag that kills traffic add a kill-switch and a rollback plan.

isabel: small process note: for service-impacting flags we require a short deployment playbook and to page oncall if rolling above 25%. i'll approve after i see the ticket.

arjun: ok opening ENG-IT now, i'll include the rollout plan and LD username. tagging @sam once it's up. thanks folks! :thumbsup:
